evidence.claim: TAA-17 shows high or moderate membranous expression in 34 of 50 profiled ovarian tumour samples.
evidence.uncertainty: Small retrospective tissue set; assay cut-off is provisional.

retrieval_trace.query: What biological and biomarker evidence changes the candidate-nomination decision for TAA-17?

evidence.claim: Expression is heterogeneous within and between tumours, with 16 of 50 samples below the provisional biomarker cut-off.
evidence.uncertainty: Sampling may under-represent intra-tumour heterogeneity.

retrieval_trace.query: What biological and biomarker evidence changes the candidate-nomination decision for TAA-17?

evidence.claim: A17-03 induces receptor internalisation with a median half-time of 42 minutes in high-expression cell models.
evidence.uncertainty: Measured in three engineered and two patient-derived models.

retrieval_trace.query: What biological and biomarker evidence changes the candidate-nomination decision for TAA-17?

evidence.claim: Soluble TAA-17 ectodomain was detectable in 7 of 20 plasma samples and may reduce free-antibody exposure in a subset of patients.
evidence.uncertainty: Exploratory assay; no exposure-response linkage yet.

retrieval_trace.query: What biological and biomarker evidence changes the candidate-nomination decision for TAA-17?

human_review.disposition: Pending review before use in governance

evidence.claim: The prototype IHC biomarker assay separates high- and low-expression reference samples with an illustrative cross-validated AUC of 0.86.
evidence.uncertainty: Cut-off and inter-laboratory reproducibility are not locked.

retrieval_trace.query: What biological and biomarker evidence changes the candidate-nomination decision for TAA-17?

evidence.claim: A17-03 achieved a median cellular IC50 of 0.8 nM across high-expression models.
evidence.uncertainty: In vitro models do not reproduce the full tumour microenvironment.

retrieval_trace.query: Which A17-03 efficacy findings support or challenge differentiation at candidate nomination?

evidence.claim: Low-expression models showed limited activity at clinically plausible concentrations.
evidence.uncertainty: Supports biomarker selection but narrows the likely addressable population.

retrieval_trace.query: Which A17-03 efficacy findings support or challenge differentiation at candidate nomination?

evidence.claim: A17-03 produced tumour regression in four of six high-expression PDX models.
evidence.uncertainty: Small model set; two high-expression PDX models did not regress.

retrieval_trace.query: Which A17-03 efficacy findings support or challenge differentiation at candidate nomination?

evidence.claim: Exposure-response plateaued above 10 mg/kg in the responsive PDX models.
evidence.uncertainty: Translation to human dose is not established.

retrieval_trace.query: Which A17-03 efficacy findings support or challenge differentiation at candidate nomination?

evidence.claim: One resistant high-expression PDX model showed low receptor internalisation, suggesting expression alone may be insufficient for response prediction.
evidence.uncertainty: Mechanism is inferred from one model and requires confirmation.

retrieval_trace.query: Which A17-03 efficacy findings support or challenge differentiation at candidate nomination?

evidence.claim: No cytokine-release signal was detected in human whole-blood assays up to 100-fold the cellular EC50.
evidence.uncertainty: Assay sensitivity and donor coverage limit exclusion of rare responses.

retrieval_trace.query: What evidence changes the A17-03 safety-margin assessment and translational plan?

evidence.claim: A17-03 binds activated fibroblasts and low-level corneal epithelium in the expanded normal-tissue panel.
evidence.uncertainty: Binding intensity is low; functional consequence and exposure margin are unresolved.

retrieval_trace.query: What evidence changes the A17-03 safety-margin assessment and translational plan?

evidence.claim: Cynomolgus cross-reactivity is insufficient to make the planned species a fully informative safety model.
evidence.uncertainty: Alternative translational strategy is not yet agreed.

retrieval_trace.query: What evidence changes the A17-03 safety-margin assessment and translational plan?

evidence.claim: A pilot repeat-dose study observed reversible thrombocytopenia at the highest exposure tested.
evidence.uncertainty: n=2 per group and the mechanism is not established.

retrieval_trace.query: What evidence changes the A17-03 safety-margin assessment and translational plan?

human_review.disposition: Pending review before use in governance

evidence.claim: A17-03 retained 98.2% monomer after three freeze-thaw cycles in the lead formulation.
evidence.uncertainty: Short-term stress condition only.

decisions.question: Which construct should advance into candidate-nomination studies?
decisions.outcome: Advance A17-03; retain A17-05 as backup.
decisions.rationale: A17-03 combined the strongest potency, receptor internalisation and early developability profile. Governance accepted expression heterogeneity as a biomarker-development risk rather than a reason to stop.
decisions.dissent: Safety representative requested earlier expansion of normal-tissue binding and cross-reactivity work.

decisions.question: Should A17-03 advance into IND-enabling development?
decisions.outcome: Conditional nomination proposed; final decision pending human review.
decisions.rationale: The candidate has a credible efficacy and biomarker case, but nomination should remain conditional on resolving normal-tissue risk, tox-model strategy and high-concentration formulation.
accepted_risks: Uncertain human translation of pilot platelet finding

criteria.name: Biological rationale & patient selection
criteria.threshold: Biomarker strategy supported and major biological uncertainties explicit.

criteria.name: Efficacy & differentiation
criteria.threshold: Reproducible activity in relevant models with a credible differentiation hypothesis.

criteria.name: Safety margin
criteria.threshold: Normal-tissue risk and translational safety plan acceptable to governance.

criteria.name: Developability / CMC
criteria.threshold: Manufacturing and formulation path feasible for the intended route.

criteria.name: Strategic fit
criteria.threshold: Aligned to portfolio priorities and investment constraints.

criteria.name: Competitive positioning
criteria.threshold: A defensible biomarker, construct or development advantage is articulated.

signals.title: Simulated competitor safety update
signals.summary: A fictional Phase I competitor update reports grade 3 keratitis in two of twelve patients and a temporary enrolment pause.
signals.suggested_action: Re-open the safety-margin criterion, compare construct and exposure differences, and request human review before the nomination meeting.

signals.title: Portfolio strategy directive
signals.summary: Biomarker-defined antibody programmes remain a priority, but an explicit normal-tissue risk-mitigation path is required.
signals.suggested_action: Make biomarker cut-off and normal-tissue risk mitigation explicit nomination conditions.

suggestions.title: Safety translation strategy is incomplete
suggestions.trigger: No informative cross-reactive species and no approved alternative strategy.
suggestions.recommendation: Assign a human safety review to define the translational package and decision threshold before nomination.

suggestions.title: Strong efficacy is constrained by target heterogeneity
suggestions.trigger: Accepted evidence supports high-expression activity while low-expression and non-internalising models remain resistant.
suggestions.recommendation: Lock the biomarker hypothesis and specify which patient segment the nomination decision covers.

suggestions.title: External safety signal may change the nomination case
suggestions.trigger: New external evidence after the previous review affects an unresolved safety criterion.
suggestions.recommendation: Compare the external signal with A17-03 binding, exposure and mitigation plans, then record whether the decision rationale changes.

actions.action: Expand normal-tissue binding review, including corneal and activated-stromal tissues.
Agree alternative safety translation plan given limited cynomolgus cross-reactivity.
Lock biomarker assay cut-off and inter-laboratory reproducibility plan.
Complete formulation screen to reduce viscosity at the intended concentration.
Update differentiation assessment after the simulated competitor signal is reviewed.

reconsideration_triggers: New evidence of clinically relevant normal-tissue toxicity in the target class.
Failure to demonstrate an acceptable alternative safety-translation strategy.
Biomarker assay reproducibility below the agreed governance threshold.
Formulation work does not support a feasible administration route.
A competitor demonstrates materially superior efficacy or safety in the selected patient segment.

human_disposition.note: The pilot thrombocytopenia finding, E-014, was omitted and must be reviewed before the answer is decision-ready.

rules.name: Evidence gap
rules.logic: Flag when a required decision criterion has no accepted evidence or when an explicit dependency remains unresolved.
rules.output: Suggestion requiring named human owner and due date.

rules.name: Evidence conflict
rules.logic: Flag when accepted supporting and challenging evidence address the same criterion with high applicability.
rules.output: Side-by-side evidence set; no automated resolution.

rules.name: Decision-change trigger
rules.logic: Flag new evidence dated after the last review when it affects an unresolved criterion or reconsideration trigger.
rules.output: Human review request and versioned rationale update.
